capabilityDescriptions.Metrics: Quantitative indicators that show how systems and applications are performing in real time.
capabilityDescriptions.Trace: Request flow data that reveals how calls travel across services and where latency or errors occur.
capabilityDescriptions.Log: Detailed records of system and application events, useful for troubleshooting and auditing.
capabilityDescriptions.RedMetric: Service-level indicators summarizing request rate, error rate, and response duration.
capabilityDescriptions.ServiceInstance: Individual runtime entities of an application, used for fine-grained analysis and correlation.
capabilityDescriptions.Topology: A visual map of components and their dependencies, showing how services interact in your system.
